concerns.text: T001 fails to implement Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene), which requires that datasets MUST be checksummed and recorded. 'Validate the provenance' is too vague to be executable as a checksumming task.

T002 verification is incomplete; it omits the measurable outcomes defined in SC-001 (≥ 80% cell retention) and SC-002 (≥ 20% variance increase), which are critical for determining if the preprocessing was successful.

T006 violates Constitution Principle II (Verified Accuracy). It mentions using 'verified GWAS catalogs' but does not include a concrete task to execute the Reference-Validator Agent to verify these external references.
